# Structure {.unnumbered}

The raw database is structured with a main `data/` folder in which we find a combination of each site (e.g. `Paracou/`) x all sensors (e.g `TOMST`) x all project (e.g. `ALT/`) in each folder (e.g. `Paracou_TOMST_ALT/`). All levels are documented through `README`.

```{r}
fs::dir_tree("data", recurse = 1, type = "directory")
```

Finally in each project-sensor couple we find a folder by data collection campaign with its date (e.g. `20240920/`) and associated sensors metadata (`metadata.xlsx/`) and campaigns metadata (e.g. `20240920.xlsx`). Available campaigns are described in `campaigns.xlsx/` .

```{r}
fs::dir_tree("data/Paracou_TOMST_ALT/", recurse = 0)
```

And in each campaign folder we find all the raw files (to be described by type of sensors):

```{r}
fs::dir_tree("data/Paracou_TOMST_ALT/20240920/", recurse = 0)
```
